summary: Elong Power Holding Ltd., a Beijing-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing mechanical adjustments to its outstanding Common Warrants issued in registered offerings in May, July and August 2026. Following the 45-for-1 share consolidation effected August 11, 2026, anti-dilution and downward-adjustment provisions reset the warrant exercise price to $3.80 per share as of the August 17, 2026 close, with warrant shares increased to approximately 3,193,862 Class A Ordinary Shares so aggregate exercise proceeds remain constant. No acquisition, tender, or solicitation is involved. Watch for further dilution and potential downward repricing upon future offerings.
